rationale: Add opt-in analysis features on the public facade and runtime. Stream named sampling CSV with optional constrained/free coordinates, validated pointwise units, predictions, statistic availability, planned chain outcomes and retained failures. Seal exact CSV bytes and counts in a versioned JSON manifest. Default inference APIs and sampling laws remain unchanged; this is an interchange contract, not an optimizer or convergence qualification.
